name: How to Prepare for a Burst Pipe Repair

step.name: Step 1: Know your shutoff locations: Be aware of where your main water shut…
step.text: Know your shutoff locations: Be aware of where your main water shutoff and any relevant electrical breakers are. This is critical for immediate action.

step.name: Step 2: Document the damage: Take clear photos or videos of the burst pipe…
step.text: Document the damage: Take clear photos or videos of the burst pipe and any water damage for your records and potential insurance claims.

step.name: Step 3: Clear the affected area: Move furniture, rugs, and personal items a…
step.text: Clear the affected area: Move furniture, rugs, and personal items away from the leak to prevent further damage and give plumbers clear access.

step.name: Step 4: Note any relevant details: Did you hear a sudden bang?
step.text: Note any relevant details: Did you hear a sudden bang? Has water pressure been off? Any context helps your plumber understand the situation.

step.name: Step 5: Have insurance information handy: If you plan to file a claim, know…
step.text: Have insurance information handy: If you plan to file a claim, knowing your policy details can save time.
